facts.fact: The executive secretary of Senegal's Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers (OQSF) writes that mobile money users can seek redress from a third party such as the OQSF when a provider does not resolve a problem; in its 2022 survey with CGAP only 1% did.

systems.system: OQSF (Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers)
